motions.item_title: Approve the minutes of the October 14, 2025 Planning Commission meeting. Commissioner Whiting s…
motions.motion: Commissioner Strong moved to approve the minutes of the October 14, 2025 Planning Commission meeting. Commissioner Whiting seconded the motion.
motions.headline: October 14 minutes approved
motions.summary: Minutes from the commission's October 14, 2025 meeting got the commission's approval.
motions.impact: Housekeeping for the commission's own records. Nobody outside the room is touched by it.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.A., Lower Hidden Valley Master Development Pla…
motions.motion: Commissioner Allen moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.A., Lower Hidden Valley Master Development Plan Amendment-Trails at Hidden Valley, with the following conditions: 1. To look at who is responsible for putting up the fence for the wildlife corridor and that the City investigate the comments from the Eagle Mountain Nature and Wildlife Alliance and that corridor. 2. The Preliminary Plats be divided into subsections versus one whole plat and that phasing changes be considered by the City Council, possibly switching Phase two and one. 3. That staff investigates whether or not the ridge line protection overlay applies to this property. Commissioner Hess seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Trails at Hidden Valley plan sent on with conditions
motions.summary: The commission recommended changes to the Lower Hidden Valley master development plan for Trails at Hidden Valley, asking for a closer look at a wildlife corridor and ridgeline protection.
motions.impact: If you live near Hidden Valley, watch the council vote. The commission wants the plats split into sections, phases one and two possibly swapped, and an answer on who fences the wildlife corridor.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.B., 17.64: Alternative Energy Overlay Zone wit…
motions.motion: Commissioner Hess moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.B., 17.64: Alternative Energy Overlay Zone with the condition to exclude the use of water-cooled natural gas power plant. Commissioner Strong seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Energy overlay zone, minus water-cooled gas plants
motions.summary: The commission recommended that the council adopt Chapter 17.64, the Alternative Energy Overlay Zone, with water-cooled natural gas power plants excluded from it.
motions.impact: The council has the final vote. If it agrees, no water-cooled natural gas power plant could be built under this overlay, wherever the overlay is applied.

motions.item_title: Approve Item 7.C., Firefly NPA 6 Phase, with the condition that the screening wall meets code a…
motions.motion: Commissioner Allen moved to approve Item 7.C., Firefly NPA 6 Phase, with the condition that the screening wall meets code and the agreement. Commissioner Hess seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Firefly NPA 6 phase approved
motions.summary: Firefly's NPA 6 phase won the commission's approval, on condition that its screening wall meets city code and the project's agreement.
motions.impact: The builder has to put up a screening wall that meets code. The record gives no unit count, acreage or location for this phase.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.D., Interconnectivity Code Amendment, with the…
motions.motion: Commissioner Hess moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.D., Interconnectivity Code Amendment, with the condition to apply to the CN, CC, CR, MEC, and OP zones. Commissioner Whiting seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Interconnectivity code change limited to five zones
motions.summary: The commission recommended that the council adopt an interconnectivity amendment to city code, on condition that it apply to the CN, CC, CR, MEC and OP zones.
motions.impact: Nothing changes until the council votes. The record names the five zones the rule would cover but does not say what it would require of them.
